mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the average return in these periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in quarterly GDP growth and monthly industrial production signals robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ and INDPRO growth > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%), the Federal Reserve typically implements aggressive rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%, or the average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a healthy labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.7 million units per month signal strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.7 million units, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment indicate a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a supply-side contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns during recessionary regimes over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: recession regime (INDPRO growth < 0% for two months)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0% for two consecutive months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
